      protected void addSemantic(java.lang.String semanticName, int quoteNumber, double value)

      protected void addSemantic(java.lang.String semanticName, int quoteNumber, java.lang.Object infinityOrError)
      to addSemantic into calccedo engine like >> tan(90) >> ERROR >> Infinity.class Hint: this method take three arguments (String,double,Infinity.class) like: addSemantic("tan", 90 , Infinity.class ) addSemantic("akw", 0 , Error.class );
      protected void addVariable(java.lang.String variableName, double variableValue)
      to add variables into calccedo Engine like: addVariable(x,5); addVariable(y,10); addVariable(z,15);
      protected void configAngel(Angel angel_type)
      is a method to set angel (REDIANS | DEGREES) before calccedo start processing like: configAngel( Angel.DEGREES );
      protected void enableDeepTrace(boolean enabled)
      to help in tracing calccedo step by step if it set to true like: enableDeepTrace(true);
      protected void init()
      is a startup method in calccedo to config all calccedo needs plus that adding some semantics and constants, like: addSemantic("sin",30, 0.5); addSemantic("sin",90, 1); addSemantic("cos",90.0, 0); addConstant("pi", 3.14);
      protected void injectFunction(java.lang.Class operationalClass, java.lang.String methodName)
      to inject function into calccedo Engine like: add( Mathematics.class , "deviation" )
      protected void injectFunction(java.lang.String functionName, java.lang.Class operationalClass, java.lang.String methodName)
      to inject function into calccedo Engine like: add("dev" , Mathematics.class , "deviation" );
      protected void removeConstant(java.lang.String constantName)
      to remove constant from calccedo Engine like: removeConstant("saturday"); removeConstant("sunday"); removeConstant("monday"); removeConstant("tuesday"); removeConstant("wedensdasy"); removeConstant(thusday"); removeConstant("friday");
      protected void removeFunction(java.lang.String functionName)
      to remove function from calccedo Engine removeFunction("deviation"); removeFunction("dev");
      protected void removeSemantic(java.lang.String semanticName, double quoteNumber)
      to remove semantic from calccedo Engine like: removeSemantic("sin",30.0); removeSemantic("cos",60.0)

      remove semantic from calccedo Engine like: removeSemantic("sin",30); like: removeSemantic("cos",60);
      protected void removeVariable(java.lang.String variableName)
      to remove variable from calccedo Engine like: removeVariable("x"); like: removeVariable("y"); like: removeVariable("z");
      protected void set(java.lang.String functionName, java.lang.Class operationalClass, java.lang.String newMethodName)
      to edit and update reference method of added function like set("dev" , Matematics.class , deviation_extra)
